title: 第25章 进入别墅暗中污染第26章 调整时间信息交流
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
“咕咚！来都来了！”
看着面无表情的美女门卫，李笑笑咽了口唾沫，低声呢喃着小心翼翼的靠近过去。
而在她抬脚的瞬间，脚下血字轰然崩溃、消散。
“外来者，离开这里！”
在李笑笑两人靠近之后，美女门卫立即上前阻止。
“呃…”
李笑笑动作顿住。
她就知道，在这诡异的死亡空间，副本没有那么简单，不可能让她那么轻松的完成任务。
与此同时，小小抓住她的手，微微用了用力，似乎有些紧张与害怕。
李笑笑低头，便看到小小紧张的看着两个美女门卫，脸上的诡异笑容已经尽数收敛，眼角留下的血痕，也已经消失无踪。
看上去，就像是一个紧张害怕的小女孩。
她们所在的位置，已经进入了楚泽涛的梦境空间，小小作为外来者，更是死亡空间的衍生存在，自然会受到极大的压制。
若不是李笑笑与其有着特殊联系，能够为其提供一定的力量支持，她的身体就算不会崩溃消散，也必然变得虚弱无比、难以动弹。
而且，那两个美女保安还是被孟天同化的存在，在死亡空间的位格上，也要比她强上一些，双重压力下，她这才如此紧张，甚至说是恐惧。
至于李笑笑…
她可同样也是现实人类，有了身体支撑精神，虽然无法完全的免疫，但也能够在一定程度上，对抗楚泽涛的梦境空间压制。
大概和在死亡空间相差无几吧，也是能够发挥出两点力量的。
甚至，她若能够进一步解放自身精神，就是发挥出个数十上百点力量，那也都是没有问题的。
不像孟天，刚一进入的时候，只能携带一点力量。
就算是最强状态，也很难超出二十。

他的力量缺少真实的身体支撑，和现实人类相比，就显得虚假与梦幻了，更是后继乏力。
在面对相对真实的现实人类梦境之时，自然会被全面压制。
只有梦境空间，或者说是梦境之主的潜意识，感觉到没有威胁的力量，也就是一点力量之下才能进入。
亦或者侵蚀了部分梦境空间，拥有了一定的梦境空间权柄之后，这才能够增强自身掌控的力量。
不过哪怕如此，生命的本能也会作出限制，难以超出二十点。
而李笑笑他们这些现实世界的人类，因为力量同样“真实”的缘故，自然能够进行一定的抵消，得以携带更强的力量。
当然了，这就不是李笑笑现在能够知道的了。
“这…”
看着畏畏缩缩的小小，李笑笑不禁一阵无言。
果然，不管是人是鬼，都会有害怕的时候。
无非就是恐惧的事物不同而已。
content_en:
"Gudong! It's coming!"
Looking at the expressionless beautiful guard, Li Xiaoxiao swallowed, murmured in a low voice and cautiously approached.
The moment she raised her foot, the bloody words beneath her feet collapsed and dissipated.
"Outsiders, get out of here!"
After Li Xiaoxiao and the two approached, the beautiful guard immediately stepped forward to stop them.
"Uh..."
Li Xiaoxiao paused.
She knew that in this strange dead space, the copy was not that simple, and it was impossible for her to complete the task so easily.
At the same time, Xiaoxiao grabbed her hand and used a little force, seeming a little nervous and scared.
Li Xiaoxiao lowered his head and saw Xiaoxiao nervously looking at the two beautiful doormen. The weird smile on his face had disappeared, and the blood stains left at the corners of his eyes had disappeared.
She looked like a nervous and scared little girl.
Their location has entered Chu Zetao's dream space. As an outsider and a derivative of the death space, Xiaoxiao will naturally be greatly suppressed.
If Li Xiaoxiao didn't have a special connection with her and could provide her with a certain amount of strength support, even if her body wouldn't collapse and dissipate, it would definitely become extremely weak and difficult to move.
Moreover, the two beautiful security guards were still assimilated by Meng Tian, ​​and their status in the dead space was stronger than hers. Under the double pressure, she was so nervous, even afraid.
As for Li Xiaoxiao...
She is also a real human being. With her body supporting her spirit, although she is not completely immune, she can still resist Chu Zetao's dream space suppression to a certain extent.
It's probably the same as in Dead Space, and it can also exert two powers.
Even if she can further liberate her spirit and exert dozens or hundreds of points of power, there will be no problem.
Unlike Meng Tian, ​​when he first entered, he could only carry a little power.
Even in the strongest state, it is difficult to exceed twenty.
His power lacks real physical support. Compared with real humans, it seems false and dreamy, and it is even more ineffective.
When faced with the relatively real reality of human dreams, nature will be completely suppressed.
Only the dream space, or the subconscious mind of the dream owner, can enter with a little force if it feels no threatening power.
Or perhaps it erodes part of the dream space, and only after possessing a certain amount of authority over the dream space can the power of one's own control be enhanced.
But even so, the instinct of life will set limits and it will be difficult to exceed twenty points.
As for humans like Li Xiaoxiao and others in the real world, because their power is also "real", they can naturally offset it to a certain extent and carry stronger power.
Of course, this is not what Li Xiaoxiao can know now.
"This..."
Seeing the timid Xiaoxiao, Li Xiaoxiao couldn't help but be speechless for a while.
Sure enough, no matter whether you are a human or a ghost, you will always be afraid.
It's just that the things to fear are different.
